lead_time_detail.note: Lead time is measured against a fixed-limit baseline on raw telemetry channels, limits set at mean +/- 3 sigma from healthy satellites, same 60-window persistence rule. On IRNSS-1G the baseline confirms 1 day earlier. Both detectors confirm after fault onset, never before. Positive lead_time_days means CUSUM confirmed first.

clock_comparison.note: Healthy imported and indigenous clock populations are statistically indistinguishable in this synthetic telemetry (0.2% apart). The comparison becomes meaningful with real per-clock data. The all-satellite figure is confounded: every faulted satellite carries an imported clock.
